title: sheer valance
text: sheer valance. While I did purchase this to go with another set of sheer lower curtains, the material of this valance did not match the more mesh material of the curtain I chose.  My window is a difficult size to get - so, I will keep looking.  Can't rate less than 5 stars though because the valance is very nice, exactly as represented.  Honestly, I wish the curtain was the same material.
